ambient_events: A section of roofing lets go somewhere nearby and comes down with a long, tired crash.
Wind moves through a hundred empty window-frames at once, one low toneless moan.
Dust drifts across the dead street in slow, aimless curls.
Deep in a collapsed building, something shifts its weight and settles again.
description: This is where the city simply gives up. The last blocks of Old Coldwater sag into their own flooded basements, streets dead-ending in dust, rebar, and drifts of shattered glass. Nobody has lived out here in a very long time — you can read it in every caved roofline and every door left standing open on nothing.
name: The Falloff
